summary: Comprehensive testing of JasprChain L1 TESTNET with continuous simulation features. All 25 new feature tests passed (100%). 20 validators working, P2P network running (is_running=true), Move VM active (functions_called > 0), block production every 2 seconds, real-time WebSocket updates working. Frontend displays all features correctly.

minor.issue: Simulated peers (5) are being cleaned up by inactive peer cleanup loop after ~2 minutes. P2P shows is_running=true but connected_peers=0. This is expected behavior - simulated peers don't respond to pings so they get removed.
minor.suggestion: To keep simulated peers visible, either: 1) Update last_seen timestamp periodically for simulated peers, or 2) Mark simulated peers to skip cleanup
